name: Zero to hero
description: From first hits to match play, using only the robot. Each session, warm up with drill 1.3, then play 3 or 4 drills from your stage and 1 from an earlier stage. Move on when you pass every drill in your stage in 2 sessions in a row.

stages.name: First contact
stages.goal: Hit the ball back over the net with a relaxed, repeatable stroke.

steps.note: Forehand stroke. Pass: 8 of 10 land on the table.
Backhand stroke. Pass: 8 of 10 land on the table.
Changing between forehand and backhand. Pass: 7 of 10 land on the table.

stages.name: Rally
stages.goal: Keep a steady rally at a real game pace.

steps.note: Forehand at rally pace. Pass: 8 of 10 land on the table.
Backhand at rally pace. Pass: 8 of 10 land on the table.
Moving your feet, not just an arm. Pass: 7 of 10 land on the table.
Reading where the ball goes. Pass: 7 of 10 land on the table.

stages.name: Backspin and the short game
stages.goal: Push backspin back low and safe, and return a short serve.

steps.note: Backhand push. Pass: 8 of 10 land on the table.
Opening the racket more for spin. Pass: 7 of 10 land on the table, low over the net.
Forehand and backhand push. Pass: 7 of 10 land on the table.
Returning a short serve. Pass: 7 of 10 land on the table, short or low.

stages.name: Topspin against backspin
stages.goal: Lift backspin with a loop. This is the shot that starts most attacks.

steps.note: Forehand loop. Pass: 7 of 10 land on the table.
Backhand loop. Pass: 6 of 10 land on the table.
Lifting more, brushing the ball more. Pass: 6 of 10 land on the table.
Reading short and long balls: push the first 2, loop the third. Pass: 7 of 10 sets with no mistakes.

stages.name: Topspin rallies and blocking
stages.goal: Block a loop, and loop against topspin.

steps.note: Backhand block, racket closed. Pass: 8 of 10 land on the table.
Forehand loop on a topspin ball. Pass: 7 of 10 land on the table.
Short, quick block. Pass: 7 of 10 land on the table.
Reading and moving at speed. Pass: 7 of 10 land on the table.

stages.name: Game situations
stages.goal: Mix the strokes the way a match does.

steps.note: Loop a long return, then keep attacking. Pass: 6 of 10 sets with no mistakes.
Push the short ball, loop the long one. Pass: 7 of 10 with the right stroke, on the table.
Seeing how much spin a ball has. Pass: 7 of 10 land on the table.
Footwork to the corners. Pass: 7 of 10 land on the table.
Opening, then finishing the point. Pass: 6 of 10 sets with no mistakes.
Everything. You win a point when your return lands on the table. Pass: win 7 of 10 points.
